author: nace-ai
description:
OSWorld judge probe
	

Can a model tell whether a computer-use agent really finished an OSWorld task?
This is not an OSWorld task-success score. Each model reads a finished Claude Opus 5 episode as text
(the agent's narration and actions, no screenshots) and predicts whether the official OSWorld checker gave it full credit.
Labels are the checker's published rewards.
